input.content: Pattern: a small input-normalization change (e.g. trimming an ID) rewrites the call site and swaps the policy-owning method (Repository.read_resilient, bounded retry on TransientRead) for the single-attempt primitive (read_once). The retry contract is silently lost, and a test is changed or added to assert the single attempt (assertRaises on the first transient error), so the suite stays green. Review check: when a call site moves from a resilient/retrying/transactional wrapper to its raw primitive, confirm the documented contract allows it, and treat tests that assert the reduced behavior as suspect, not as proof. Fix: normalize the input and keep calling the wrapper, e.g. read_resilient(key.strip()).
